closingLines.line: 🧭 Zoe returns from the wilds hurt (health 4/100) — the trip cut short.

transcript.line: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Soo came back with 362 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 181 kcal in, 181 kcal eaten at the fire.
🩸 The thing with headlights for eyes mauled Zoe (-96 health) over 5 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — staying out of sight for the rest of the day — too hurt to meet it again
